user.description: Create a Circadian Pro instance. Each instance can control multiple lights.

menu.title: Create or Duplicate

init.title: General settings
init.description: Configure general behavior. Next you'll enter the real Kelvin of the W channel and calibrate 4000K and 1000K.

data.take_over_control: Give up control on manual changes

data_description.lights: List of lights controlled by this instance (may be empty).
data_description.interval: How often settings are recalculated and applied.
data_description.transition: Transition time used when adapting lights and when enabling/disabling sleep mode.
data_description.initial_transition: Transition time for the first change when turning on a light.
data_description.sleep_rgb_or_color_temp: How color is defined in sleep mode.
data_description.sleep_color_temp: Sleep color temperature (if using color temperature).
data_description.sleep_rgb_color: Sleep RGB color (if using RGB). In this mode the W channel is forced to 0.
data_description.sleep_transition: Transition time when enabling/disabling sleep mode.
data_description.sleep_schedule_start: Start time for the fixed sleep schedule (only used when the automatic sleep mode is set to "By schedule").
data_description.sleep_schedule_end: End time for the fixed sleep schedule (only used when the automatic sleep mode is set to "By schedule").
data_description.take_over_control: If enabled, pauses adaptation when manual changes are detected.
data_description.sunrise_offset: Shifts sunrise by adding or subtracting seconds. Positive values delay sunrise and negative values advance it.
data_description.sunset_offset: Shifts sunset by adding or subtracting seconds. Positive values delay sunset and negative values advance it.
data_description.sunrise_time: Forces a fixed sunrise time every day instead of using Home Assistant's calculated sun time. If set to None, the real sunrise time is used based on your location and date.
data_description.min_sunrise_time: Sets a lower bound so the virtual sunrise will not occur earlier than this time even if the real sunrise is earlier. If None, no limit is applied.
data_description.max_sunrise_time: Sets an upper bound so the virtual sunrise will not occur later than this time even if the real sunrise is later. If None, no limit is applied.
data_description.sunset_time: Forces a fixed sunset time every day instead of using Home Assistant's calculated sun time. If set to None, the real sunset time is used based on your location and date.
data_description.min_sunset_time: Sets a lower bound so the virtual sunset will not occur earlier than this time even if the real sunset is earlier. If None, no limit is applied.
data_description.max_sunset_time: Sets an upper bound so the virtual sunset will not occur later than this time even if the real sunset is later. If None, no limit is applied.
data_description.brightness_mode_time_dark: How many seconds the brightness transition towards night lasts around sunset. Higher values make the change smoother and slower. Only applies when brightness_mode is linear or tanh; with default it is ignored or has little effect.
data_description.brightness_mode_time_light: How many seconds the brightness transition towards day lasts around sunrise. Higher values make the change smoother and slower. Only applies when brightness_mode is linear or tanh; with default it is ignored or has little effect.
data_description.sleep_activation_mode: Choose how sleep mode is enabled automatically. Disabled: only manual sleep switch. By sunrise/sunset: sleep mode from sunset until sunrise. By schedule: sleep mode only within the schedule below.

white_w_kelvin.title: White channel (W)
white_w_kelvin.description: Enter the real Kelvin of the dedicated white channel (W) of your RGBW strip (for example, 3000K).

data_description.white_w_kelvin: Actual Kelvin of the dedicated W (white) LED in your strip. From 4000K down to this value, the W channel stays at the 4000K level; below it, W is progressively reduced towards the 1000K calibration.

cal_neutral.title: Calibration 4000K
cal_neutral.description: Calibration panel for 4000K. Adjust RGB and W to get a pleasant neutral white.

cal_warm.title: Calibration 1000K
cal_warm.description: Calibration panel for 1000K. Adjust RGB and W to force a warm/orange look. Usually lowering W helps the red dominate.

error.option_error: One or more options are invalid.
error.entity_missing: A configured light entity no longer exists.
error.invalid_brightness_range: Minimum brightness cannot be greater than maximum brightness.
error.invalid_color_temp_range: Minimum color temperature cannot be greater than maximum color temperature.
error.invalid_brightness_window: For Linear or Sigmoid mode, the combined light and dark transition window must be greater than zero.
error.invalid_sunrise_bounds: Earliest sunrise cannot be later than latest sunrise.
error.invalid_sunset_bounds: Earliest sunset cannot be later than latest sunset.
